sources.edition: Œuvres complètes du cardinal de Bérulle, éd. Migne, Paris, 1856 (reprint of Bourgoing’s 1644 collected edition); archive.org OCR (ABBYY) of the Toronto copy.
sources.description: Machine-cleaned OCR: running heads, page numbers and hyphenation removed, paragraphs rejoined, obvious character errors corrected by a vote against the corpus vocabulary. Residual OCR errors, merged columns and some chapter openings the scan lost remain (see PROBLEMS.md).
sources.tierEvidence: Bérulle died in 1629; the 1856 edition is public domain.
